items.text: Malik Nabers is active for Sunday Night Football after murky/questionable knee status that was left up to him post-warmups; Giants had elevated PS WRs earlier as contingency.
items.why: Practiced fully all week post-ACL; decision deferred to player after pregame; confirmed active ~90 min pre-kick.
items.implication: Start in all formats; primary target for Jaxson Dart vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if no decoy limitation; high-upside WR1/2.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as Cardinals would not activate if overly concerned about ankle. Confirmed expected/active by multiple.
items.why: Ankle sprain; progressive positive reports; listed RB2 but expected to play vs Chargers.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with risk of limited workload; monitor snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Rookie role expansion possible; goal-line/third-down upside if healthy enough.

items.text: Rome Odunze officially active today after calf injury that had him questionable/expected.
items.why: Calf limited practice; Rapoport/ETR expected to go vs Panthers.
items.implication: Viable WR3/flex but monitor snap share if managed.
items.opportunity: Downfield routes in Bears offense; pair with Loveland/Burden usage.

items.text: Sunday AM: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) EXPECTED; Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED; Josh Williams ACTIVATED (Tucker doubtful); Nabers (knee) no news yet.
items.why: Weekend reports compilation for inactive window.
items.implication: Core guide for morning lineup locks; later confirmed actives/inactives.
items.opportunity: Etienne boost from Kamara; Love/Odunze playable.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (MCL sprain/knee) not expected to play and inactive vs Lions despite late full participation; not quite ready.
items.why: Knee/MCL; full Friday but sources say sidelined.
items.implication: Sit Kamara; elevates NO backfield volume.
items.opportunity: Clear path for Etienne as lead; Miller RB2.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early after huge first half (5/150/1); ruled out for game; prior camp issues. Watching for extent.
items.why: Hamstring grab mid-game after explosive plays; Q to return then OUT.
items.implication: Monitor Week 2 status closely; big performance truncated.
items.opportunity: Short-term boost to Likely/Andrews and other BAL WRs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest) left early after strong start (5/82/1); questionable then did not return. Watching.
items.implication: Check severity for Week 2; Johnston etc. step up short-term.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston and LAC TEs see increased targets.

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers wherever owned despite decoy risk now that active; risk/reward but play him.
items.why: Active confirmation post-uncertainty; talent overrides decoy worry.
items.opportunity: High target share potential vs Cowboys secondary.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT (wrist); initial diagnosis fractured wrist, further MRI, out several weeks.
items.why: Wrist injury in game; fracture confirmed via sources.
items.implication: Longer absence; Ravens WR thin with Flowers also exiting.
items.opportunity: More work for remaining BAL WRs/TEs (Andrews/Likely).

items.text: Jeremiyah Love risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere owned; activation signals confidence in ankle.
items.why: Would not activate if major concern; Cardinals context noted.
items.implication: RB2 start with volatility on workload.

items.text: AJ Brown high ankle sprain will not need surgery but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle; confirmed no surgery needed.
items.implication: IR/stash candidate; NE WR depth elevated long-term short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to other NE pass-catchers while out.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; Raiders believe realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers pending how he feels.
items.implication: Sit W1; stash for potential quick return; Mayer primary fill-in.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer target share spike (prior 24% without Bowers).

items.text: Kamara status (not expected) directly affects projections for Travis Etienne and NO backfield.
items.implication: Etienne elevated to strong RB start/top-10 upside.
items.opportunity: Unchallenged lead back; passing downs + carries.

items.text: Main slate news largely locked; only major projection swing was Malik Nabers (Q knee) for SNF which was murky/up-to-him; PS elevations noted. No other major changes.
items.why: Full practice but player decision; later resolved ACTIVE.
items.implication: Projections live/updating; Nabers the key variable pre-active.
items.opportunity: If in, full usage; if out Berrios/Cambre elevated.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.why: Post-game observation amid BAL WR injuries (Flowers/Lane).
items.implication: TE streamer/start candidate ROS if role sticks.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/TE targets with Flowers limited and Lane out.

items.text: Combine in-game watches (Flowers hamstring, McConkey chest, BTJ shoulder, Murray concussion, etc.) with Bowers knee, AJ Brown ankle, Darnold hip, Stribling ankle — not a clean injury start.
items.why: Multiple early exits and pre-existing absences.
items.implication: Elevated waiver/handcuff priority and Week 2 status checks.
items.opportunity: Backups and secondary options gain immediate value.

items.text: Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) amid contract murkiness/trade possibility.
items.implication: PIT secondary adjustment; limited fantasy skill impact.

items.text: Josh Williams activated; Sean Tucker doubtful — TB backfield note for Irving/Gainwell split context.
items.why: Practice squad/ elevation move with Tucker doubtful.
